scope: Synthetic Squirrel sandbox, one previously delivered invitation

evidence.https_one_click_post_context: Replay against a recipient already suppressed by the prior human-readable unsubscribe test
evidence.prior_human_unsubscribe_database_result: One merchant-wide suppression and one acquisition withdrawal recorded

smtp2go_activity.scope: Exact synthetic message, read-only activity search

limitations: The hosted one-click POST was an idempotent replay, not the first operation creating suppression.
Gmail authentication results are provider-reported; no independent DKIM signature verification was performed.
The test API key's activity-read permission was enabled for this qualification.
The original test invitation retains its 60-day expiry; later test invitations are configured without time expiry.
privacy: No email address, message ID, capability, key, or raw MIME source is retained here.
